name: Wave Audit — Comprehensive Project Analysis
description: Full-spectrum audit of t27 project: GitHub issues analysis, weakness identification, SOTA research review, decomposed plan, and implementation of critical fixes.
author: opencode-agent

phases.name: Issue Triage
phases.description: Collect all open GitHub issues, categorize by priority/area, identify critical patterns
phases.output: Categorized issue table with severity ratings

phases.name: Weakness Analysis
phases.description: Deep exploration of compiler, specs, tests, CI, FPGA pipeline, build system, documentation
phases.output: Root cause analysis table with structural and scientific weaknesses

phases.name: SOTA Research Review
phases.description: Review competing work: BitNet b1.58, posit/unum, code LLMs, symbolic regression, formal HW verification

phases.name: Decomposed Plan
phases.description: 5-phase implementation plan: Critical Fixes -> Compiler Health -> RTL/Silicon -> Scientific Strengthening -> IGLA-Coder
phases.output: Phased plan with effort estimates and dependencies

phases.name: Implementation
phases.description: Fix highest-impact issues: W112 math errors, W82 security vulnerabilities

phases.name: Report + Cooperation Variants
phases.description: Comprehensive audit report with 3 cooperation variants for next Wave loop

constitutional_compliance.L1_TRACEABILITY: All changes traced to issue #990 (W112) and #958 (W82)
constitutional_compliance.L3_PURITY: All changes are ASCII-only with English identifiers
constitutional_compliance.L4_TESTABILITY: Spec fixes include corrected test invariants
constitutional_compliance.L5_IDENTITY: Mathematical fixes verified against phi^2 + phi^-2 = 3
